topic: Introduction to squadron hangar / second line hangar layout, Duties and responsibilities of AMCO, Aircraft movement and hangar evacuation plan
syllabus_extract: Introduction to squadron hangar / second line hangar layout, Duties and responsibilities of AMCO, Aircraft movement and hangar evacuation plan, near miss scheme and filling up of near miss forms store (Identification of POL, safety precautions, POL hygiene, current orders in force). Responsibility and action during removal of unserviceable items from aircraft.
